overrides.decision: Require the unchanged v1 state, conductance, current, charge, holding and negative-control gates on new calibration and confirmation schedules. At an event timestamp the state observable is left-continuous, matching the native sampling phase; the analytic conductance remains unchanged because A and B jump equally. No retrospective promotion of v1.
overrides.scope: Isolated canonical receptor kernels, one observed release per synapse, fixed voltage. State-sampling semantics corrected prospectively on new schedules. No IV-C2/IV-C3 or Task33 claim.
